_doc: What feeds each slice of the map. Paths: relative to the workspace (parent of stackmap), or ~/… . refresh-plan.mjs reports a slice as changed when a repo has commits since the last refresh, a file or a folder entry was modified since then, or (hosting) the Zeabur project/service names differ. `scope` is what the re-mapping agent owns; it is pasted into its brief.

hermes.scope: Hermes: you own `hermes` and every node under it (ids `hermes-*`). Read hermes-sandbox CLAUDE.md, docs/, tasks/, cron/, auditor/, incidents/ as the changes point to, plus memories/decisions/hermes.md.

hosting.scope: Hosting: you own zeabur, zeabur-frankfurt, every zb-* Zeabur project/service/database, vercel*, gcp*, neon*, cloudflare, namecheap, github*, plesk*, supabase, domain-*, and the backup nodes. Live, read-only: `zeabur project list -i=false`, `zeabur service list --project-id <id> -i=false`; never a mutating zeabur verb.

claude-code.scope: Claude Code and the workspace: you own claude-code, vscode-workspace, hf-hub, mcp-hub and every cc-*/ws-* node. MCP servers: names and commands only from ~/.claude.json and .mcp.json files — never env values. Never read credential files.

buzz.scope: Buzz and Fizz: you own buzz, fizz and every buzz-*/fizz-* node. Bots: role from agents/<bot>.prompt.md in one line. Never call buzz_write, fleet_power, fleet_channel_set or persona_set; never read key files.

products.scope: Products: you own every proj-* node and its parts (proj-<name>-*), and biglobster-llc. Hosting-side nodes (zb-*, vercel-*, gcp-*, neon-*, domain-*) belong to the hosting slice: point edges at them, do not edit them.
